name.zh: 借墙反弹，把攻击送到拐角
name.en: Bounce a shot around a corner

summary.zh: 墙面成为弹道的一部分，打不到的目标也可能有间接路线。
summary.en: Walls become part of the firing path and create indirect routes to targets.

rules.zh: 投射物碰到允许反弹的表面后改变方向，并消耗次数或能量。玩家用墙的位置与角度安排间接攻击，也要观察反弹是否把危险带回自己身边；反弹结束后重新寻找下一条路线。
rules.en: A projectile changes direction at eligible surfaces and spends bounce count or energy. Use wall geometry for indirect attacks, while considering whether the returning path creates danger; then find a new route for the next shot.

loop.zh: 寻找目标与可反弹墙面
loop.en: Find the target and a usable wall

loop.zh: 换角度或换位置再发射
loop.en: Change angle or position for the next shot

decisions.zh: 直射更可靠，借墙能保持掩护但路线更难判断。
decisions.en: A direct shot is reliable; a bank shot preserves cover but is harder to predict.

decisions.zh: 多次反弹能扫更大范围，也可能浪费在空处或带来自伤风险。
decisions.en: More bounces cover more space but can waste shots or create self-harm risk.

effect.zh: 次数多会放大场地几何的重要性；逐次衰减能限制无限扫场。
effect.en: More bounces make geometry matter more; decay prevents indefinite room coverage.

effect.zh: 材质与标记应清楚区分反弹、吸收和穿透，避免靠猜。
effect.en: Clearly distinguish reflective, absorbing and penetrable surfaces.

observation.zh: 系统参考图：俯视房间内可见角色、敌人、掩体与弹幕。
observation.en: System reference: A top-down room shows the character, enemies, cover and projectiles. See the linked text source for the rules.

implementation.zh: Charge Shot 发射能穿透敌人、并在墙面反弹的能量弹，玩家可用房间边界延长弹道覆盖。
implementation.en: Charge Shot fires a projectile that pierces enemies and bounces from walls, allowing room boundaries to extend its coverage.

implementation.zh: Bounce 修饰法术给兼容投射物加入碰撞反弹行为；与其他法术组合后，玩家需要重新判断反弹路径。
implementation.en: The Bounce modifier adds bouncing behavior to compatible projectiles, changing how combined wand spells interact with surfaces.

observation.zh: 系统参考图：提供本作的场景语境，不把静态画面作为本条操作过程的证明。
observation.en: System reference: provides context for this game; the still image does not establish this interaction sequence.

contrast.zh: 挺进地牢把反弹作为特定枪械的规则；Noita 允许把反弹加入法术组合，适用边界更需要说明。
contrast.en: Gungeon packages bouncing in a weapon; Noita lets it modify spell combinations, making compatibility boundaries more important.

combination.zh: 组合提案：允许玩家在战斗前吸附摆放少量反射板，用有限板件规划能绕过掩体的射线。
combination.en: Design proposal: snap a limited set of reflective panels into place before combat to route shots around cover.

setup.zh: 敌人在直角墙后，正面射线被挡住。
setup.en: An enemy is hidden behind a right-angle wall.

action.zh: 玩家向旁边的斜反射板开火。
action.en: The player fires toward a slanted reflective panel.

result.zh: 弹丸反弹到墙后，消耗一次反弹机会。
result.en: The shot reaches behind the wall and spends one bounce.

next.zh: 敌人换位后，玩家也要调整发射点而非重复原角度。
next.en: When the enemy moves, the player must revise the firing point.

firstStep.zh: 做一个房间、一种固定速度的弹丸和最多一次反弹，先显示路线辅助线。
firstStep.en: Build one room, a fixed-speed projectile and one allowed bounce, initially with a guide line.

pitfall.zh: 角落、薄墙和高速碰撞最容易让反弹结果失真。
pitfall.en: Corners, thin walls and high-speed collisions are the likeliest sources of misleading results.

test.zh: 玩家能否在第二次尝试前预测弹丸会从哪面墙离开？
test.en: Can players predict which wall the shot will leave after the next attempt?
